data.name: The Remaining
data.detailed_description:
The Remaining is a dark third person action adventure set in a fractured world on the edge of collapse.

After humanity’s experiments with dimensional travel went too far, reality began to break apart. Now, a massive black hole slowly consumes what is left of the world, pulling entire lands, timelines and forgotten places into its endless darkness.

At the center of this dying reality stands a ruined medieval castle, suspended between dimensions. Once a place of power, it has become the heart of a broken world. Around it, shattered islands float in the void, portals lead into unstable realms, and every path brings you closer to the truth behind the collapse.

You play as a warrior caught in the remains of this disaster, forced to travel through different dimensions, fight corrupted enemies and face powerful bosses shaped by the worlds they inhabit. Each realm offers its own atmosphere, dangers and story fragments, revealing more about the experiments, the people who controlled them, and the man who still rules from the castle.

Combat is focused on heavy melee weapons, precise movement and cinematic encounters. Spears, axes and other brutal weapons give every fight weight, while special abilities let you push deeper into places that should no longer exist.

But this is not only a fight for survival. The world is disappearing piece by piece, and the closer you get to the center, the more you uncover about your own past, your family, and the betrayal that caused everything to fall apart.

The world is ending.

Only The Remaining can decide what comes after.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel /AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
  • Additional Notes: Typical Unreal Engine 5 requirements
